description: Header file defining the HttpNetworkTransaction class, which manages HTTP network transactions within the Chromium networking stack. It includes method declarations, state management, and references to related classes and components.

classes.name: HttpNetworkTransaction
classes.description: Manages an HTTP network transaction, handling request initiation, response processing, authentication, retries, and state transitions within the Chromium networking stack.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the HTTP transaction with the specified request info, callback, and net log.

methods.name: RestartIgnoringLastError
methods.description: Restarts the transaction ignoring the last error.

methods.name: RestartWithCertificate
methods.description: Restarts the transaction with a client certificate and private key.

methods.name: RestartWithAuth
methods.description: Restarts the transaction with provided authentication credentials.

methods.name: IsReadyToRestartForAuth
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is ready to restart for authentication.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer asynchronously.

methods.name: StopCaching
methods.description: Stops caching for this transaction.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: DoneReading
methods.description: Indicates that reading is complete.

methods.name: GetResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the response info object.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state.

methods.name: SetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Associates QUIC server info with the transaction.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the remote endpoint address.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority.

methods.name: SetWebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper
methods.description: Sets the helper for creating WebSocket handshake streams.

methods.name: SetBeforeNetworkStartCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to run before network start.

methods.name: SetConnectedCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for when connection is established.

methods.name: SetRequestHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for request headers.

methods.name: SetEarlyResponseHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for early response headers.

methods.name: SetResponseHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for response headers.

methods.name: ResumeNetworkStart
methods.description: Resumes network start if paused.

methods.name: CloseConnectionOnDestruction
methods.description: Closes the connection when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: OnStreamReady
methods.description: Callback when stream is ready.

methods.name: OnBidirectionalStreamImplReady
methods.description: Callback when bidirectional stream is ready.

methods.name: OnWebSocketHandshakeStreamReady
methods.description: Callback when WebSocket handshake stream is ready.

methods.name: OnStreamFailed
methods.description: Callback when stream creation fails.

methods.name: OnCertificateError
methods.description: Callback for certificate errors.

methods.name: OnNeedsProxyAuth
methods.description: Callback when proxy authentication is needed.

methods.name: OnNeedsClientAuth
methods.description: Callback when client authentication is needed.

methods.name: OnQuicBroken
methods.description: Callback when QUIC is broken.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns connection attempts info.
